owner_boundary.summary: Lode declares checks; Core owns operation lifecycle and authorization; Harbor supplies refs-only page and effect evidence.

status_meaning.passed: The named action, operation ref, business effect, content readback and reconciliation agree with refs-only evidence.
status_meaning.failed: A required fact, ref, effect mapping, readback or no-out-of-scope invariant is missing or mismatched.
status_meaning.skipped: The static fixture cannot execute a live action; skipped is not a success claim.

result_contract.unknown_policy: accepted/running/unknown_outcome are preserved from Core; unknown external effect or reconciliation is never upgraded and never retried.
result_contract.submitted_policy: submitted is true only after Core records that the named external action was initiated; it never substitutes for business-effect readback.

requirements.description: Verify exactly one action: save_draft maps to create; publish maps to publish.
requirements.on_failure: Return invalid_contract or operation_result_unknown; never select the other action.

requirements.description: Preserve the Core-owned operation ref and terminal or unknown outcome without creating a second lifecycle.
requirements.on_failure: Return operation_result_unknown and expose same-operation recovery; never retry automatically.

requirements.description: Re-read the uniquely marked draft or published item, fields and media through refs-only page evidence.
requirements.on_failure: Return post_check_failed or reconciliation_unknown and preserve unknown values.

requirements.description: Confirm save_draft does not publish and publish does not replay a prior save or unknown publish.

fixture_post_check_output.reason: Static fixture does not execute save-draft or publish; live packaged evidence belongs to WebEnvoy #419/#422/#423.

failure_boundary.login_required: No managed identity fact; return unavailable.
failure_boundary.permission_insufficient: Account or business target is not confirmed; do not execute.
failure_boundary.page_changed: Route or exact commit control differs from the contract; stop.
failure_boundary.commit_control_unavailable: The exact save-draft or publish control is unavailable.
failure_boundary.operation_result_unknown: Effect or terminal state is unclear; query and reconcile the same operation, no replay.
failure_boundary.post_check_failed: Required list/detail/content readback or refs are missing or mismatched.
failure_boundary.reconciliation_unknown: Operation exists but marked content cannot be reconciled.

real_page_validation.reason: Static Lode fixtures are not live evidence and cannot complete the product issues.
required_later_runtime: Core/Harbor/App operation, snapshot, post-check and reconciliation refs

non_goals: No browser execution or live post-check runner in Lode.
No upload, field fill, cleanup, retry, bypass, raw evidence or second lifecycle.
